decisions.visual_basis: Only the central monitor has all four bezel sides and corners inside the original frame. The left and right neighboring monitors cross the original image borders. The central same-subject card reads S24DG302EC and 3,690.

The original full frame is a broad display wall with at least seven complete monitors. A foreground FollowMe unit is present, but it does not override the project-wide distant-scene rule when three or more complete monitor bodies are visible.
